headline: A reviewer who tried Google's free AI video maker in Google Vids says it is fun to use but too glitchy to threaten Hollywood.
score_reason: Pool score 2 kept: one reviewer's test of a free Google tool, honest limits shown.
importance_line: Anyone with a computer can try free AI video making, which touches video creators first and studios later, but this is one writer's opinion of a single test.
summary: Android Police reports that a writer tried the free AI video generator in Google Vids, Google's video editor, and found it easy and funny but flawed: speech stutters, characters change between shots, and the 'Extend' feature adds at most 20 seconds. He concludes it is fun to play with and that Hollywood has nothing to worry about yet, which is his own opinion.
notes: Read from the pre-fetched page. Pool title mentions Gemini; the article names Google Vids.
